targets.rawSql:
SELECT dbo.udf_get_sql_server_version(sqlserver_product_version) AS Version
FROM dbo.mssql247_sql_instance

SELECT sqlserver_edition AS Edition
FROM dbo.mssql247_sql_instance

SELECT sql_cpu + (100 - (idle_cpu + sql_cpu)) AS CPU , collection_datetime_utc
FROM (SELECT record.value('(./Record/SchedulerMonitorEvent/SystemHealth/ProcessUtilization)[1]', 'int') sql_cpu ,
      record.value('(./Record/SchedulerMonitorEvent/SystemHealth/SystemIdle)[1]', 'int') idle_cpu, collection_datetime_utc
FROM (SELECT ring_buffer_address, ring_buffer_type, collection_datetime_utc, CAST(record AS XML) record 
    FROM dbo.mssql247_os_ring_buffers
    WHERE ring_buffer_type IN ('RING_BUFFFER_RESOUCE_MONITOR', 'RING_BUFFER_SCHEDULER_MONITOR')) AS ss ) ss
WHERE $__timeFilter(collection_datetime_utc)
ORDER BY collection_datetime_utc

SELECT ((total_physical_memory_kb * 1. - available_physical_memory_kb * 1.) / total_physical_memory_kb) * 100. AS Memory
FROM dbo.mssql247_os_sys_memory
WHERE $__timeFilter(collection_datetime_utc)
ORDER BY collection_datetime_utc

SELECT total_physical_memory_kb AS [Total Server Memory]
FROM dbo.mssql247_os_sys_memory

SELECT physical_memory_in_use_kb AS [SQL Server Memory (in use)]
FROM dbo.mssql247_os_process_memory

SELECT cpu_count AS [CPU Count]
FROM dbo.mssql247_os_sys_info

SELECT COUNT(*) AS [RESTORING]
FROM dbo.mssql247_databases
WHERE state = 'RESTORING'
AND collection_datetime_utc = (SELECT MAX(collection_datetime_utc) FROM dbo.mssql247_databases)

SELECT REPLACE(volume_name, '(C:)', '') + ' (' + volume_mount_point + ')' volume_mount_point, ((total_size_kb - size_remaining_kb) / (total_size_kb * 1.) * 100.) FROM dbo.mssql247_os_volumes
WHERE collection_datetime_utc = (SELECT MAX(collection_datetime_utc) FROM dbo.mssql247_os_volumes)

SELECT cntr_value AS [Active Temp Tables] FROM dbo.mssql247_performance_counters
WHERE (counter_name =  'Active Temp Tables')
AND $__timeFilter(collection_datetime_utc)
ORDER BY collection_datetime_utc

DECLARE @LastSnapshotTStamp DATETIME 
SET @LastSnapshotTStamp = (SELECT MAX(collection_datetime_utc) FROM dbo.mssql247_performance_counters p)
DECLARE @SecondToTheLastSnapshotTStamp DATETIME 
SET @SecondToTheLastSnapshotTStamp = (SELECT MAX(collection_datetime_utc) FROM dbo.mssql247_performance_counters p
                                        WHERE collection_datetime_utc <> @LastSnapshotTStamp)
DECLARE @SnapshotDateDiff INT = DATEDIFF(SECOND, @SecondToTheLastSnapshotTStamp, @LastSnapshotTStamp)
;WITH cteBatchRequestsCapturedLast (value)
AS (SELECT TOP 1 cntr_value AS 'Batch Requests/sec'
    FROM dbo.mssql247_performance_counters p
    WHERE object_name = 'SQLServer:SQL Statistics'
    AND counter_name = 'Batch Requests/sec'
    AND collection_datetime_utc = @LastSnapshotTStamp),
cteBatchRequestsCapturedSecondToTheLast (value)
AS (SELECT TOP 1 cntr_value AS 'Batch Requests/sec'
    FROM dbo.mssql247_performance_counters p
    WHERE object_name = 'SQLServer:SQL Statistics'
    AND counter_name = 'Batch Requests/sec'
    AND collection_datetime_utc = @SecondToTheLastSnapshotTStamp)
SELECT CASE WHEN @SnapshotDateDiff = 0 THEN ((SELECT value FROM cteBatchRequestsCapturedLast) - 
            (SELECT value FROM cteBatchRequestsCapturedSecondToTheLast)) ELSE ((SELECT value FROM cteBatchRequestsCapturedLast) - 
            (SELECT value FROM cteBatchRequestsCapturedSecondToTheLast)) / @SnapshotDateDiff END AS 'Batch Requests/sec'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS [Blocked]
FROM dbo.mssql247_blocked_query_stats
WHERE blocked_query_status = 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT name) AS [Databases]
FROM dbo.mssql247_databases
WHERE collection_datetime_utc = (SELECT MAX(collection_datetime_utc) FROM dbo.mssql247_databases)

SELECT SUM(size * 8) AS [Total Data File Size]
FROM dbo.mssql247_master_files
WHERE collection_datetime_utc = (SELECT MAX(collection_datetime_utc)
                                  FROM dbo.mssql247_master_files)
AND type = 0

SELECT SUM(size * 8) AS [Total Log File Size]
FROM dbo.mssql247_master_files
WHERE collection_datetime_utc = (SELECT MAX(collection_datetime_utc)
                                  FROM dbo.mssql247_master_files)
AND type = 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS [SUSPECT]
FROM dbo.mssql247_databases
WHERE state = 'SUSPECT'
AND collection_datetime_utc = (SELECT MAX(collection_datetime_utc) FROM dbo.mssql247_databases)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS [EMERGENCY]
FROM dbo.mssql247_databases
WHERE state = 'EMERGENCY'
AND collection_datetime_utc = (SELECT MAX(collection_datetime_utc) FROM dbo.mssql247_databases)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS [OFFLINE]
FROM dbo.mssql247_databases
WHERE state = 'OFFLINE'
AND collection_datetime_utc = (SELECT MAX(collection_datetime_utc) FROM dbo.mssql247_databases)

SELECT sql_cpu, idle_cpu, (100 - (sql_cpu+idle_cpu)) other, collection_datetime_utc
FROM (SELECT record.value('(./Record/SchedulerMonitorEvent/SystemHealth/ProcessUtilization)[1]', 'int') sql_cpu ,
      record.value('(./Record/SchedulerMonitorEvent/SystemHealth/SystemIdle)[1]', 'int') idle_cpu, collection_datetime_utc
FROM (SELECT ring_buffer_address, ring_buffer_type, collection_datetime_utc, CAST(record AS XML) record 
    FROM dbo.mssql247_os_ring_buffers
    WHERE ring_buffer_type IN ('RING_BUFFFER_RESOUCE_MONITOR', 'RING_BUFFER_SCHEDULER_MONITOR')) AS ss ) ss
WHERE $__timeFilter(collection_datetime_utc)
ORDER BY collection_datetime_utc

SELECT SUM((io_stall_read_ms)/num_of_reads) avg_read_stall_ms,
  SUM((io_stall_write_ms)/(num_of_writes+1)) avg_write_stall_ms,
  collection_datetime_utc
FROM dbo.mssql247_file_io_stats
WHERE $__timeFilter(collection_datetime_utc)
GROUP BY collection_datetime_utc
ORDER BY collection_datetime_utc ASC

SELECT SUM((io_stall_read_ms)/num_of_reads) avg_read_stall_ms,
  SUM((io_stall_write_ms)/(num_of_writes+1)) avg_write_stall_ms,
  collection_datetime_utc
FROM dbo.mssql247_file_io_stats
WHERE $__timeFilter(collection_datetime_utc)
GROUP BY collection_datetime_utc
ORDER BY collection_datetime_utc ASC

SELECT SUM((num_of_bytes_read)/(num_of_reads + 1)) AS avg_reads_kb,
  SUM((num_of_bytes_written)/(num_of_writes + 1)) AS avg_writes_kb,
  collection_datetime_utc
FROM dbo.mssql247_file_io_stats
WHERE $__timeFilter(collection_datetime_utc)
GROUP BY collection_datetime_utc
ORDER BY collection_datetime_utc

SELECT committed_memory_kb AS bpool_committed_kb, 
  committed_target_kb AS bpool_target_kb,
  collection_datetime_utc
FROM dbo.mssql247_os_sys_info
WHERE $__timeFilter(collection_datetime_utc)
ORDER BY collection_datetime_utc

SELECT COUNT(*) blocked_sessions, DATEADD(HOUR, -8, start_time)
FROM dbo.mssql247_blocked_query_stats
GROUP BY start_time
ORDER BY start_time

SELECT session_id, start_time, sql_text, blocking_session_id, wait_type, wait_time, host_name, login_name, program_name, client_net_address, open_transaction_count, transaction_id
FROM dbo.mssql247_blocked_query_stats
WHERE blocked_query_status <> 0

;WITH cteHeadBlocker (blocking_tree_group, session_id, blocking_spid, blocking_level)
AS (SELECT spid, spid, blocked, 1 FROM sys.sysprocesses s 
    WHERE blocked = 0
    AND EXISTS (SELECT blocking_session_id FROM sys.dm_exec_requests    
                    WHERE blocking_session_id <> 0
                    AND blocking_session_id = s.spid)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT blocking_tree_group, r.session_id, r.blocking_session_id, blocking_level + 1 FROM sys.dm_exec_requests r
    INNER JOIN cteHeadBlocker blocker 
    ON r.blocking_session_id = blocker.session_id
    AND r.blocking_session_id <> 0)
SELECT cteHeadBLocker.session_id, CASE WHEN cteHeadBlocker.blocking_spid = 0 THEN 'HEAD BLOCKER' ELSE 'BLOCKED' END, t.text, cteHeadBlocker.blocking_spid, cteHeadBlocker.blocking_level, s.spid FROM cteHeadBLocker
INNER JOIN sys.sysprocesses s ON cteHeadBlocker.session_id = s.spid
INNER JOIN sys.dm_exec_connections c ON c.session_id = s.spid
CROSS APPLY sys.dm_exec_sql_text(c.most_recent_sql_handle) t
ORDER BY cteHeadBlocker.blocking_tree_group ASC, cteHeadBlocker.blocking_level ASC
